name: Yin Bao
title: Assistant Professor
department: Plant and Soil Sciences; Mechanical Engineering; Ag-CyPhER Lab
fitReason: Active agricultural robotics lab with current supervised graduate projects connecting trained perception to real fruit handling. The 2023 Delaware arrival was an institution move after an Auburn faculty appointment, not a first-career hire.

physicalEvidence.status: Current own-advised university project with named trained perception and physical fruit handling; project-report evidence, physical 23
physicalEvidence.summary: University and competition-organizer accounts verify the 2026 UD Blue Hens vision-guided watermelon system. YOLO-based detection is integrated with an Amiga-mounted arm, compliant vacuum gripper and vine-cutting mechanism to locate, grip and transfer melons. Bao is a named advisor; several named builders are current lab graduate researchers. This establishes a current directed physical project, but no full methods paper, trial count, intervention rate or unattended field reliability was verified. The report does not establish learned low-level motion control.

shortVisit.summary: Current graduate and robotics-MS supervision is independently visible. No explicit external-master visitor invitation or summer 2027 opening was verified. Envision is an undergraduate program with older 2025 dates, so its listing is not counted as an applicable offer.

scoreReasons.fit: Applied trained robot perception and real manipulation; broader plant-sensing portfolio rather than a control/RL-specialist lab.
scoreReasons.physical: Current local directed student hardware with named YOLO integration, conservatively below full-methods maximum.
scoreReasons.shortVisit: Current degree advising and undergraduate summer mentoring do not establish an external-master visit offer.
scoreReasons.freshness: Dated May/June 2026 completed project and current 2026 graduate roster.
